verses.geez:
ወነበቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ ሞተ ፡ ክልኤሆሙ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ አሮን ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዘአምጽኡ ፡ እሳተ ፡
                  እምባዕድ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወሞቱ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses after the two sons of Aaron died in bringing strange fire before the Lord, so they died.

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses after the two sons of Aaron died in bringing strange fire before the Lord, so they died.
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the LORD, and died;
translations.ron: După moartea celor doi fii ai lui Aaron, care au murit când au adus foc străin înaintea feţei Domnului, a grăit Domnul cu Moise;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, μετὰ τὸ τελευτῆσαι τοὺς δύο υἱοὺς Ἀαρὼν ἐν τῷ προσάγειν αὐτοὺς πῦρ ἀλλότριον ἔναντι Κυρίου, καὶ ἐτελεύτησαν.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብል ፡ በሎ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ እኁከ ፡ ኢይባእ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ሰዓት ፡ ውስተ ፡
                  ቅድሳት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ውስጡ ፡ ለመንጦላዕት ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ምሥሃል ፡ ዘመልዕልተ ፡ ታቦት ፡ ወኢይመውት ፡ እምከመ ፡ ባሕቱ ፡
                  በደመና ፡ አስተርአይኩ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Speak to Aaron thy brother, and let him not come in at all times into the holy place within the veil before the propitiatory, which is upon the ark of the testimony, and he shall not die; for I will appear in a cloud on the propitiatory.

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to Moses, Speak to Aaron thy brother, and let him not come in at all times into the holy place within the veil before the propitiatory, which is upon the ark of the testimony, and he shall not die; for I will appear in a cloud on the propitiatory.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the vail before the mercy seat, which is upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.
translations.ron: Şi a zis Domnul către Moise: "Spune lui Aaron, fratele tău, să nu intre oricând în locaşul sfânt de după perdea, înaintea curăţitorului celui de pe chivotul legii, ca să nu moară, că deasupra capacului Mă voi arăta în nor.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, λάλησον πρὸς Ἀαρὼν τὸν ἀδελφόν σου, καὶ μὴ εἰσπορευέσθω πᾶσαν ὥραν εἰς τὸ ἅγιον ἐσώτερον τοῦ καταπετάσματος εἰς πρόσωπον τοῦ ἱλαστηρίου, ὅ ἐστιν ἐπὶ τῆς κιβωτοῦ τοῦ μαρτυρίου, καὶ οὐκ ἀποθανεῖται· ἐν γὰρ νεφέλῃ ὀφθήσομαι ἐπὶ τοῦ ἱλαστηρίου.

verses.geez:
እምዝ ፡ ይባእ ፡ አሮን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቅድሳት ፡ ምስለ ፡ ላህም ፡ ዘእምውስተ ፡ አልህምት ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአት ፡ ወበግዕ
                  ፡ ለ[መሥዋዕት] ።
verses.translation: Thus shall Aaron enter into the holy place; with a calf of the herd for a sin-offering, and having a ram for a whole-burnt-offering.

translations.lxx: Thus shall Aaron enter into the holy place; with a calf of the herd for a sin-offering, and having a ram for a whole-burnt-offering.
translations.kjv: Thus shall Aaron come into the holy place: with a young bullock for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.
translations.ron: Iată rânduiala după care trebuie să intre Aaron în locaşul sfânt: cu un viţel, jertfă pentru păcat, şi cu un berbec pentru ardere de tot.
translations.grk: Οὕτως εἰσελεύσεται Ἀαρὼν εἰς τὸ ἅγιον· ἐν μόσχῳ ἐκ βοῶν περὶ ἁμαρτίας, καὶ κριὸν εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα.

verses.geez:
ወልብሰ ፡ ዐጌ ፡ ቅዱሰ ፡ ይልበስ ፡ ወቃሰ ፡ ዘዐጌ ፡ ይደይ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሥጋሁ ፡ ወቅናተ ፡ ዘዐጌ ፡ ይቅነት ፡ ወልብሰ
                  ፡ ዐጌ ፡ ዘቂዳርን ፡ ይልበስ ፡ እስመ ፡ አልባስ ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወተኀፂቦ ፡ በማይ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ሥጋሁ ፡ ይልበሶሙ ።
verses.translation: And he shall put on the consecrated linen tunic, and he shall have on his flesh the linen drawers, and shall gird himself with a linen girdle, and shall put on the linen cap, they are holy garments; and he shall bathe all his body in water, and shall put them on.

translations.lxx: And he shall put on the consecrated linen tunic, and he shall have on his flesh the linen drawers, and shall gird himself with a linen girdle, and shall put on the linen cap, they are holy garments; and he shall bathe all his body in water, and shall put them on.
translations.kjv: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these are holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and so put them on.
translations.ron: Să se îmbrace cu hitonul de în sfinţit, să aibă pe trupul lui pantaloni de în, să fie încins cu brâu de în şi să-şi ia şi chidar de în: acestea sunt veşmintele sfinţite; dar să-şi spele tot trupul său cu apă şi numai aşa să se îmbrace cu ele.
translations.grk: Καὶ χιτῶνα λινοῦν ἡγιασμένον ἐνδύσεται, καὶ περισκελὲς λινοῦν ἔσται ἐπὶ τοῦ χρωτὸς αὐτοῦ, καὶ ζώνῃ λινῇ ζώσεται, καὶ κίδαριν λινῆν περιθήσεται, ἱμάτια ἅγιά ἐστι· καὶ λούσεται ὕδατι πᾶν τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐνδύσεται αὐτά.

verses.geez:
እምውስተ ፡ ተዓይኖሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ይንሣእ ፡ ክልኤተ ፡ ሐራጊተ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ አጣሊ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኀጢአት ፡
                  ወበግዐ ፡ አሐደ ፡ ለመሥዋዕት ።
verses.translation: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin-offering, and one lamb for a whole-burnt-offering.

translations.lxx: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin-offering, and one lamb for a whole-burnt-offering.
translations.kjv: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.
translations.ron: Iar de la obştea fiilor lui Israel să ia din turma lor doi ţapi de jertfă pentru păcat şi un berbec pentru arderea de tot.
translations.grk: Καὶ παρὰ τῆς συναγωγῆς τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ λήψεται δύο χιμάρους ἐξ αἰγῶν περὶ ἁμαρτίας, καὶ κριὸν ἕνα εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα.

verses.geez: ወያበውእ ፡ አሮን ፡ ላህመ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአቱ ፡ ወያስተሰሪ ፡ ለርእሱ ፡ ወለቤቱ ።
verses.translation: And Aaron shall bring the calf for his own sin-offering, and shall make atonement for himself and for his house.

translations.lxx: And Aaron shall bring the calf for his own sin-offering, and shall make atonement for himself and for his house.
translations.kjv: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.
translations.ron: Să aducă Aaron. pentru sine viţelul de jertfă pentru păcat, ca să se cureţe pe sine şi casa sa.
translations.grk: Καὶ προσάξει Ἀαρὼν τὸν μόσχον τὸν περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐξιλάσεται περὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወእምዝ ፡ ያስተሰሪ ፡ በእልክቱ ፡ ክልኤቱ ፡ ሐራጊት ፡ ወያቀውሞሙ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ኀበ ፡ ኆኅተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡
                  ዘመርጡል ።
verses.translation: And he shall take the two goats, and place them before the Lord by the door of the tabernacle of witness.

translations.lxx: And he shall take the two goats, and place them before the Lord by the door of the tabernacle of witness.
translations.kjv: And he shall take the two goats, and present them before the LORD at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
translations.ron: Apoi să ia cei doi ţapi şi să-i pună înaintea feţei Domnului la uşa cortului adunării.
translations.grk: Καὶ λήψεται τοὺς δύο χιμάρους, καὶ στήσει αὐτοὺς ἔναντι Κυρίου παρὰ τὴν θύραν τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου.

verses.geez:
ወይወዲ ፡ አሮን ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ክልኤሆሙ ፡ ሐራጊት ፡ ዕፀወ ፡ ዘቦቱ ፡ ያስተዓፁ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ዕፅ ፡ ዘእግዚአብሔር ፡
                  ወአሐዱ ፡ ዕፅ ፡ ለዘ ፡ አብአ ።
verses.translation: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats, one lot for the Lord, and the other for the scape-goat.

translations.lxx: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats, one lot for the Lord, and the other for the scape-goat.
translations.kjv: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.
translations.ron: Şi să arunce Aaron sorţi asupra celor doi ţapi: un sorţ pentru al Domnului şi un sorţ pentru al lui Azazel.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπιθήσει Ἀαρὼν ἐπὶ τοὺς δύο χιμάρους κλῆρους· κλῆρον ἕνα τῷ Κυρίῳ, καὶ κλῆρον ἕνα τῷ ἀποπομπαίῳ.

verses.geez: ወያመጽኦ ፡ አሮን ፡ ለሐርጌ ፡ ዘወድቀ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ዕፀ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወያበውኦ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኀጢአት ።
verses.translation: And Aaron shall bring forward the goat on which the lot for the Lord fell, and shall offer him for a sin-offering.

translations.lxx: And Aaron shall bring forward the goat on which the lot for the Lord fell, and shall offer him for a sin-offering.
translations.kjv: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the LORD’s lot fell, and offer him for a sin offering.
translations.ron: După aceea să ia Aaron ţapul, asupra căruia a căzut sorţul Domnului, şi să-l aducă jertfă pentru păcat,
translations.grk: Καὶ προσάξει Ἀαρὼν τὸν χίμαρον ἐφʼ ὃν ἐπῆλθεν ἐπʼ αὐτὸν ὁ κλῆρος τῷ Κυρίῳ, καὶ προσοίσει περὶ ἁμαρτίας.

verses.geez:
ወሐርጌሰ ፡ ዘወድቀ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ዕፀ ፡ ዘአምጽአ ፡ ያቀውሞ ፡ ሕያዎ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ያስተስሪ ፡ ቦቱ
                  ፡ ወከመ ፡ ይፈንዎ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ያግዕዝዎ ፡ ወየኀድግዎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገዳም ።
verses.translation: And the goat upon which the lot of the scape-goat came, he shall present alive before the Lord, to make atonement upon him, so as to send him away as a scape-goat, and he shall send him into the wilderness.

translations.lxx: And the goat upon which the lot of the scape-goat came, he shall present alive before the Lord, to make atonement upon him, so as to send him away as a scape-goat, and he shall send him into the wilderness.
translations.kjv: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make an atonement with him, and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.
translations.ron: Iar ţapul asupra căruia a căzut sorţul pentru Azazel să-l pună viu înaintea Domnului, ca să săvârşească asupra lui curăţirea şi să-i dea drumul în pustie pentru ispăşire, ca să ducă acela cu sine nelegiuirile lor în pământ neumblat.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὸν χίμαρον, ἐφʼ ὃν ἐπῆλθεν ἐπʼ αὐτὸν ὁ κλῆρος τοῦ ἀποπομπαίου, στήσει αὐτὸν ζῶντα ἔναντι Κυρίου, τοῦ ἐξιλάσασθαι ἐπʼ αὐτοῦ, ὥστε ἀποστεῖλαι αὐτὸν εἰς τὴν ἀποπομπήν, καὶ ἀφήσει αὐτὸν εἰς τὴν ἔρημον.

verses.geez:
ወያበውእ ፡ አሮን ፡ ላህመ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአቱ ፡ ወያስተሰሪ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ወለቤቱ ፡ ወይጠብሖ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ላህም ፡
                  ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአቱ ።
verses.translation: And Aaron shall bring the calf for his sin, and he shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and he shall kill the calf for his sin-offering.

translations.lxx: And Aaron shall bring the calf for his sin, and he shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and he shall kill the calf for his sin-offering.
translations.kjv: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself:
translations.ron: Apoi să aducă Aaron viţelul de jertfă pentru păcatele sale, ca să se cureţe pe sine şi casa sa şi să junghie viţelul jertfă pentru păcatele sale;
translations.grk: Καὶ προσάξει Ἀαρὼν τὸν μόσχον τὸν περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας αὑτοῦ, καὶ ἐξιλάσεται περὶ ἑαυτοῦ, καὶ τοῦ οἴκου· καὶ σφάξει τὸν μόσχον περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወይነሥእ ፡ ማዕጠንተ ፡ ወይመልእ ፡ እሳተ ፡ እምፍሕም ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ዘቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወይመልእ ፡
                  እዴሁ ፡ እምነ ፡ ዕጣን ፡ ዘዕዩን ፡ ዘድቁቅ ፡ ወያበውእ ፡ ውስጠ ፡ እምነ ፡ መንጦላዕት ።
verses.translation: And he shall take his censer full of coals of fire off the altar, which is before the Lord; and he shall fill his hands with fine compound incense, and shall bring it within the veil.

translations.lxx: And he shall take his censer full of coals of fire off the altar, which is before the Lord; and he shall fill his hands with fine compound incense, and shall bring it within the veil.
translations.kjv: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the vail:
translations.ron: Să ia cărbuni aprinşi de pe jertfelnicul cel dinaintea Domnului, o cădelniţă plină, şi aromate pisate mărunt pentru tămâiere două mâini pline, şi să le ducă înăuntru, după perdea;
translations.grk: Καὶ λήψεται τὸ πυρεῖον πλῆρες ἀνθράκων πυρὸς ἀπὸ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου, τοῦ ἀπέναντι Κυρίου· καὶ πλήσει τὰς χεῖρας θυμιάματος συνθέσεως λεπτῆς, καὶ εἰσοίσει ἐσώτερον τοῦ καταπετάσματος.

verses.geez:
ወይወዲ ፡ ውእተ ፡ ዕጣነ ፡ ውስተ ፡ [ማዕጠንት ፡] ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወይከድን ፡ ጢሱ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ምሥሃለ ፡
                  ዘዲበ ፡ ታቦት ፡ ወኢይመውት ።
verses.translation: And he shall put the incense on the fire before the Lord, and the smoke of the incense shall cover the mercy-seat over the tables of testimony, and he shall not die.

translations.lxx: And he shall put the incense on the fire before the Lord, and the smoke of the incense shall cover the mercy-seat over the tables of testimony, and he shall not die.
translations.kjv: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is upon the testimony, that he die not:
translations.ron: Să pună aromatele pe focul din cădelniţă înaintea felei Domnului, astfel ca norul de fum să acopere capacul cel de pe chivotul legii, ca să nu moară Aaron.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπιθήσει τὸ θυμίαμα ἐπὶ τὸ πῦρ ἔναντι Κυρίου· καὶ καλύψει ἡ ἀτμὶς τοῦ θυμιάματος τὸ ἱλαστήριον τὸ ἐπὶ τῶν μαρτυρίων, καὶ οὐκ ἀποθανεῖται.

verses.geez:
ወይነሥእ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ደሙ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ላህም ፡ ወይነዝኅ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምሥሃል ፡ ለመንገለ ፡ ሠርቁ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገጹ ፡
                  ለምሥሃል ፡ ይነዝኅ ፡ ስብዕ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ደም ፡ በአጽባዕቱ ።
verses.translation: And he shall take of the blood of the calf, and sprinkle with his finger on the mercy-seat eastward: before the mercy-seat shall he sprinkle seven times of the blood with his finger.

translations.lxx: And he shall take of the blood of the calf, and sprinkle with his finger on the mercy-seat eastward: before the mercy-seat shall he sprinkle seven times of the blood with his finger.
translations.kjv: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.
translations.ron: Să ia şi din sângele viţelului şi să stropească cu degetul său spre răsărit peste capac; şi înaintea capacului să stropească de şapte ori sânge cu degetul său.
translations.grk: Καὶ λήψεται ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ μόσχου, καὶ ῥανεῖ τῷ δακτύλῳ ἐπὶ τὸ ἱλαστήριον κατὰ ἀνατολάς· κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ ἱλαστηρίου ῥανεῖ ἑπτάκις ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος τῷ δακτύλῳ.

verses.geez:
ወይጠብሕ ፡ ሐርጌ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአተ ፡ ዘእምኀበ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወያበውእ ፡ እምነ ፡ ደሙ ፡
                  ውስጠ ፡ እምነ ፡ መንጦላዕት ፡ ወይገብሮ ፡ ለደሙ ፡ በከመ ፡ ገብረ ፡ ደመ ፡ ላህም ፡ ወይነዝኅ ፡ እምነ ፡ ደሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡
                  ምሥሃል ፡ መንገለ ፡ ገጹ ፡ ለምሥሃል ።
verses.translation: And he shall kill the goat for the sin-offering that is for the people, before the Lord; and he shall bring in of its blood within the veil, and shall do with its blood as he did with the blood of the calf, and shall sprinkle its blood on the mercy-seat, in front of the mercy-seat.

translations.lxx: And he shall kill the goat for the sin-offering that is for the people, before the Lord; and he shall bring in of its blood within the veil, and shall do with its blood as he did with the blood of the calf, and shall sprinkle its blood on the mercy-seat, in front of the mercy-seat.
translations.kjv: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the vail, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:
translations.ron: După aceea să junghie înaintea Domnului ţapul de jertfă pentru păcatele poporului, să ducă sângele lui înăuntru, după perdea, şi să facă cu sângele acela ce a făcut şi cu sângele viţelului, stropind cu el pe capac şi înaintea capacului.
translations.grk: Καὶ σφάξει τὸν χίμαρον τὸν περὶ ἁμαρτίας, τὸν περὶ τοῦ λαοῦ, ἔναντι Κυρίου· καὶ εἰσοίσει τοῦ αἵματος αὐτοῦ ἐσώτερον τοῦ καταπετάσματος, καὶ ποιήσει τὸ αἷμα αὐτοῦ, ὃν τρόπον ἐποίησε τὸ αἷμα τοῦ μόσχου· καὶ ῥανεῖ τὸ αἷμα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸ ἱλαστήριον, κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ ἱλαστηρίου.

verses.geez:
ወያስተሰሪ ፡ በቅዱስ ፡ እምነ ፡ ርኵሶሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወበእንተ ፡ ዐመፃሆሙ ፡ ወበእንተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ኀጣይኢሆሙ
                  ፡ ወከመዝ ፡ ይገብር ፡ ለደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ እንተ ፡ ተገብረት ፡ ውስቴቶሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ርኵሶሙ ።
verses.translation: And he shall make atonement for the sanctuary on account of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and for their trespasses in the matter of all their sins; and thus shall he do to the tabernacle of witness established among them in the midst of their uncleanness.

translations.lxx: And he shall make atonement for the sanctuary on account of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and for their trespasses in the matter of all their sins; and thus shall he do to the tabernacle of witness established among them in the midst of their uncleanness.
translations.kjv: And he shall make an atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness.
translations.ron: Aşa va curăţi locaşul sfânt de necurăţia fiilor lui Israel, de nelegiuirile lor şi de toate păcatele lor. Aşa să facă el cu cortul adunării, care se află la ei, în mijlocul necurăţeniilor lor.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξιλάσεται τὸ ἅγιον ἀπὸ τῶν ἀκαθαρσιῶν τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἀδικημάτων αὐτῶν περὶ πασῶν τῶν ἁμαρτιῶς αὐτῶν· καὶ οὕτω ποιήσει τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου τῇ ἐκτισμένῃ ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐν μέσῳ τῆς ἀκαθαρσίας αὐτῶν.

verses.geez:
ወአልቦ ፡ ዘየሀሉ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ወኢመኑ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ይበውእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ቅድሳት ፡ ከመ ፡ ያስተስሪ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡
                  ዘየሀሉ ፡ እስከ ፡ ይወፅእ ፡ ወያስተሰሪ ፡ ለርእሱ ፡ ወለቤቱ ፡ ወለኵሉ ፡ ተዓይኖሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of witness, when he goes in to make atonement in the holy place, until he shall have come out; and he shall make atonement for himself, and for his house, and for all the congregation of the children of Israel.

translations.lxx: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of witness, when he goes in to make atonement in the holy place, until he shall have come out; and he shall make atonement for himself, and for his house, and for all the congregation of the children of Israel.
translations.kjv: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy place, until he come out, and have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Israel.
translations.ron: Nici un om să nu fie în cortul adunării, când va intra el să cureţe locaşul sfânt şi până va ieşi. Aşa se va curăţi el pe sine şi casa sa şi toată obştea fiilor lui Israel.
translations.grk: Καὶ πᾶς ἄνθρώπος οὐκ ἔσται ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου, εἰσπορευομένου αὐτοῦ ἐξιλάσασθαι ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ, ἕως ἂν ἐξέλθῃ· καὶ ἐξιλάσεται περὶ ἑαυτοῦ, καὶ τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ, καὶ περὶ πάσης συναγωγῆς υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez:
ወይወፅእ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ ዘሀለወ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወያስተሰሪ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ ወይነሥእ ፡ እምነ ፡ ደም ፡
                  ዘላህም ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ደም ፡ ዘሐርጌ ፡ ወይወዲ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አቅርንቲሁ ፡ ለምሥዋዕ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዐውዶሙ ።
verses.translation: And he shall come forth to the altar that is before the Lord, and he shall make atonement upon it; and he shall take of the blood of the calf, and of the blood of the goat, and shall put it on the horns of the altar round about.

translations.lxx: And he shall come forth to the altar that is before the Lord, and he shall make atonement upon it; and he shall take of the blood of the calf, and of the blood of the goat, and shall put it on the horns of the altar round about.
translations.kjv: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before the LORD, and make an atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about.
translations.ron: Apoi va ieşi la jertfelnicul cel dinaintea Domnului şi-l va curăţi, luând din sângele viţelului şi din sângele ţapului şi punând pe coarnele jertfelnicului de jur împrejur,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξελεύσεται ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον τὸ ὂν ἀπέναντι Κυρίου, καὶ ἐξιλάσεται ἐπʼ αὐτοῦ· καὶ λήψεται ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ μόσχου, καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ χιμάρου, καὶ ἐπιθήσει ἐπὶ τὰ κέρατα τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου κύκλῳ.

verses.geez:
ወይነዝኅ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ደም ፡ በአጽባዕቱ ፡ ስብዕ ፡ ወያነጽሕ ፡ ወይቄድስ ፡ እምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡
                  ርኵሶሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And he shall sprinkle some of the blood upon it seven times with his finger, and shall purge it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.

translations.lxx: And he shall sprinkle some of the blood upon it seven times with his finger, and shall purge it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.
translations.kjv: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.
translations.ron: Şi, stropindu-l cu sânge, cu degetul său de şapte ori, îl va curăţi de necurăţeniile fiilor lui Israel şi-l va sfinţi.
translations.grk: Καὶ ῥανεῖ ἐπʼ αὐτὸ ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος τῷ δακτύλῳ ἑπτάκις, καὶ καθαριεῖ αὐτό, καὶ ἁγιάσει αὐτὸ ἀπὸ τῶν ἀκαθαρσιῶν τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez:
ወይፌጽም ፡ አስተስርዮ ፡ በቅዱስ ፡ ወበደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ወበምሥዋዕ ፡ ወያነጽሕ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ካህናትኒ ፡ ወያመጽእ
                  ፡ ሐርጌ ፡ ዘሕያው ።
verses.translation: And he shall finish making atonement for the sanctuary and for the tabernacle of witness, and for the altar; and he shall make a cleansing for the priests, and he shall bring the living goat;

translations.lxx: And he shall finish making atonement for the sanctuary and for the tabernacle of witness, and for the altar; and he shall make a cleansing for the priests, and he shall bring the living goat;
translations.kjv: And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy place, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:
translations.ron: Iar după ce va sfârşi de curăţat locaşul sfânt, cortul adunării şi jertfelnicul, şi curăţind şi pe preoţi, va aduce ţapul cel viu,
translations.grk: Καὶ συντελέσει ἐξιλασκόμενος τὸ ἅγιον, καὶ τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου, καὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον, καὶ περὶ τῶν ἱερέων καθαριεῖ· καὶ προσάξει τὸν χίμαρον τὸν ζῶντα.

verses.geez:
ወይወዲ ፡ አሮን ፡ ክልኤሆን ፡ እደዊሁ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ርእሱ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ሐርጌ ፡ ዘሕያው ፡ ወይትናሐይ ፡ በላዕሌሁ ፡ ኵሎ
                  ፡ ኀጣይኦሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ዐመፃሆሙ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ አበሳሆሙ ፡ ወይወዲ ፡ (እደዊሁ ፡) ላዕለ ፡ ርእሱ ፡
                  ለውእቱ ፡ ሐርጌ ፡ ዘሕያው ፡ ወይፌንዎ ፡ ሐቅለ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዘተረስየ ።
verses.translation: and Aaron shall lay his hands on the head of the live goat, and he shall declare over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their unrighteousnesses, and all their sins; and he shall lay them upon the head of the live goat, and shall send him by the hand of a ready man into the wilderness.

translations.lxx: and Aaron shall lay his hands on the head of the live goat, and he shall declare over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their unrighteousnesses, and all their sins; and he shall lay them upon the head of the live goat, and shall send him by the hand of a ready man into the wilderness.
translations.kjv: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness:
translations.ron: Îşi va pune Aaron mâinile sale pe capul ţapului celui viu şi va mărturisi asupra lui toate nelegiuirile fiilor lui Israel, toate nedreptăţile lor şi toate păcatele lor; şi, punându-le pe acestea pe capul ţapului, îl va trimite cu un om anumit în pustie.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπιθήσει Ἀαρὼν τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν τοῦ χιμάρου τοῦ ζῶντος, καὶ ἐξαγορεύσει ἐπʼ αὐτοῦ πάσας τὰς ἀνομίας τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ πάσας τὰς ἀδικίας αὐτῶν, καὶ πάσας τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν· καὶ ἐπιθήσει αὐτὰς ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν τοῦ χιμάρου τοῦ ζῶντος· καὶ ἐξαποστελεῖ ἐν χειρὶ ἀνθρώπου ἑτοιμου εἰς τὴν ἔρημον.

verses.geez:
ወይነሥእ ፡ ዝክቱ ፡ ሐርጌ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ርእሱ ፡ ኀጣይኦሙ ፡ ወየኀድጎ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ሐርጌ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድረ ፡ በድው ፡
                  ኀበ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዕፀ ።
verses.translation: And the goat shall bear their unrighteousnesses upon him into a desert land; and Aaron shall send away the goat into the wilderness.

translations.lxx: And the goat shall bear their unrighteousnesses upon him into a desert land; and Aaron shall send away the goat into the wilderness.
translations.kjv: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.
translations.ron: Şi va duce ţapul cu sine toate nelegiuirile lor în pământ neumblat şi omul va da drumul ţapului în pustie.
translations.grk: Καὶ λήψεται ὁ χίμαρος ἐφʼ ἑαυτῷ τὰς ἀδικίας αὐτῶν εἰς γῆν ἄβατον· καὶ ἐξαποστελεῖ τὸν χίμαρον εἰς τὴν ἔρημον.

verses.geez:
ወይበውእ ፡ አሮን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ወያነብር ፡ አልባሰ ፡ ዘላዕሌሁ ፡ ዘዐጌ ፡ ዘለብሰ ፡ ሶበ ፡
                  ለበዊእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቅድሳት ፡ ወያነብሮ ፡ ህየ ።
verses.translation: And Aaron shall enter into the tabernacle of witness, and shall put off the linen garment, which he had put on, as he entered into the holy place, and shall lay it by there.

translations.lxx: And Aaron shall enter into the tabernacle of witness, and shall put off the linen garment, which he had put on, as he entered into the holy place, and shall lay it by there.
translations.kjv: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy place, and shall leave them there:
translations.ron: După aceea va intra Aaron în cortul adunării şi se va dezbrăca de hainele cele de în, cu care se îmbrăcase la intrarea în locul cel sfânt, şi le va lăsa acolo;
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰσελεύσεται Ἀαρὼν εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου, καὶ ἐκδύσεται τὴν στολὴν τὴν λινῆν, ἣν ἐνδεδύκει, εἰσπορευομένου αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ ἅγιον, καὶ ἀποθήσει αὐτὴν ἐκεῖ.

verses.geez:
ወይትኀፀብ ፡ ሥጋሁ ፡ በማይ ፡ በመካን ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ ወይለብስ ፡ አልባሲሁ ፡ ወወፂኦ ፡ ይገብር ፡ መሥዋዕቶ ፡ ወመሥዋዕተ
                  ፡ ሕዝብኒ ፡ ወያስተሰሪ ፡ ለርእሱ ፡ ወለቤቱ ፡ ወለሕዝብኒ ፡ በከመ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ካህናት ።
verses.translation: And he shall bathe his body in water in the holy place, and shall put on his raiment, and shall go out and offer the whole-burnt-offering for himself and the whole-burnt-offering for the people: and shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and for the people, as for the priests.

translations.lxx: And he shall bathe his body in water in the holy place, and shall put on his raiment, and shall go out and offer the whole-burnt-offering for himself and the whole-burnt-offering for the people: and shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and for the people, as for the priests.
translations.kjv: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.
translations.ron: Îşi va spăla trupul său cu apă în locul cel sfânt, se va îmbrăca cu hainele sale şi, ieşind, va săvârşi arderea de tot pentru sine şi arderea de tot pentru popor, şi se va curăţi astfel pe sine, casa sa, poporul şi pe preoţi.
translations.grk: Καὶ λούσεται τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ ὕδατι ἐν τόπῳ ἁγίῳ, καὶ ἐνδύσεται τὴν στολὴν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐξελθὼν ποιήσει τὸ ὁλοκαύτωμα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ ὁλοκάρπωμα τοῦ λαοῦ, καὶ ἐξιλάσεται περὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ περὶ τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ, καὶ περὶ τοῦ λαοῦ, ὡς περὶ τῶν ἱερέων.

verses.geez: ወሥብሐ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአት ፡ ይወድዮ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ።
verses.translation: And he shall offer the fat for the sin-offering on the altar.

translations.lxx: And he shall offer the fat for the sin-offering on the altar.
translations.kjv: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.
translations.ron: Iar grăsimea jertfei pentru păcat o va arde pe jertfelnic.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὸ στέαρ τὸ περὶ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἀνοίσει ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον.

verses.geez:
ወዝክቱ ፡ ዘአውፅኦ ፡ ለሐርጌ ፡ ዘፈለጡ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያግዕዙ ፡ የኀፅብ ፡ አልባሰሁ ፡ ወይትኀፀብ ፡ ሥጋሁ ፡ በማይ ፡
                  ወእምዝ ፡ ይበውእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ትዕይንት ።
verses.translation: And he that sends forth the goat that has been set apart to be let go, shall wash his garments, and bathe his body in water, and afterwards shall enter into the camp.

translations.lxx: And he that sends forth the goat that has been set apart to be let go, shall wash his garments, and bathe his body in water, and afterwards shall enter into the camp.
translations.kjv: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.
translations.ron: Cel ce a dat drumul în pustie ţapului de ispăşire să-şi spele hainele sale, să-şi spele trupul cu apă şi atunci să intre în tabără.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὁ ἐξαποστέλλων τὸν χίμαρον τὸν διεσταλμένον εἰς ἄφεσιν, πλυνεῖ τὰ ἱμάτια, καὶ λούσεται τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ ὕδατι, καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὴν παρεμβολήν.

verses.geez:
ወላህምኒ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአት ፡ ወሐርጌኒ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአትኒ ፡ ዘአብኡ ፡ ደሞሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያስተስርዩ ፡ ቦቱ ፡
                  በውስተ ፡ ቅድሳት ፡ ያወፅእዎሙ ፡ አፍአ ፡ እምትዕይንት ፡ ወያውዕይዎሙ ፡ በእሳት ፡ ወአምእስቲሆሙኒ ፡ ወሥጋሆሙኒ ፡
                  ወካዕሴሆሙኒ ።
verses.translation: And the calf for the sin-offering, and the goat for the sin-offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, they shall carry forth out of the camp, and burn them with fire, even their skins and their flesh and their dung.

translations.lxx: And the calf for the sin-offering, and the goat for the sin-offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, they shall carry forth out of the camp, and burn them with fire, even their skins and their flesh and their dung.
translations.kjv: And the bullock for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall one carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.
translations.ron: Iar viţelul de jertfă pentru păcat Şi ţapul de jertfă pentru păcat al căror sânge a fost adus înăuntru pentru curăţirea locaşului sfânt, să se scoată afară din tabără şi să se ardă în foc pielea lor, carnea lor şi necurăţenia lor.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὸν μόσχον τὸν περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας, καὶ τὸν χίμαρον τὸν περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας, ὧν τὸ αἷμα εἰσηνέχθη ἐξιλάσασθαι ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ, ἐξοίσουσιν αὐτὰ ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς, ταὶ κατακαύσουσιν αὐτὰ ἐν πυρὶ, καὶ τὰ δέρματα αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ κρέα αὐτῶν καὶ τὴν κόπρον αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ወዝክቱ ፡ ዘአውዐዮሙ ፡ የኀፅብ ፡ አልባሲሁ ፡ ወይትኀፀብ ፡ ሥጋሁ ፡ በማይ ፡ ወእምዝ ፡ ይበውእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ትዕይንት ።
verses.translation: And he that burns them shall wash his garments, and bathe his body in water, and afterwards he shall enter into the camp.

translations.lxx: And he that burns them shall wash his garments, and bathe his body in water, and afterwards he shall enter into the camp.
translations.kjv: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
translations.ron: Cel ce le va arde să-şi spele hainele, să-şi spele trupul său cu apă şi numai după aceea să intre în tabără.
translations.grk: Ὁ δὲ κατακαίων αὐτὰ, πλυνεῖ τὰ ἱμάτια, καὶ λούσεται τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ ὕδατι, καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὴν παρεμβολήν.

verses.geez:
ወዝንቱ ፡ ሕገ ፡ ይኩንክሙ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ወበሳብዕ ፡ ወርኅ ፡ አመ ፡ ዐሡሩ ፡ ለሠርቅ ፡ አሕምምዋ ፡ ለነፍስክሙ ፡ ወኵሎ
                  ፡ ግብረ ፡ ኢትግበሩ ፡ ዘእምፍጥረቱኒ ፡ ወዘግዩርኒ ፡ ወዘሀለወኒ ፡ ኀቤክሙ ።
verses.translation: And this shall be a perpetual statute for you; in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall humble your souls, and shall do no work, the native and the stranger who abides among you.

translations.lxx: And this shall be a perpetual statute for you; in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall humble your souls, and shall do no work, the native and the stranger who abides among you.
translations.kjv: And this shall be a statute for ever unto you: that in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourneth among you:
translations.ron: Aceasta să fie pentru voi lege veşnică: în luna a şaptea, în ziua a zecea a lunii, să postiţi şi nici o muncă să nu faceţi, nici băştinaşul, nici străinul care s-a aşezat la voi,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται τοῦτο ὑμῖν νόμιμον αἰώνιον· ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ ἑβδόμῳ, δεκάτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς, ταπεινώσετε τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν, καὶ πᾶν ἔργον οὐ ποιήσετε ὁ αὐτόχθων, καὶ ὁ προσήλυτος ὁ προσκείμενος ἐν ὑμῖν.

verses.geez:
እስመ ፡ በይእቲ ፡ ዕለት ፡ ያስተሰሪ ፡ በእንቲአክሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያንጽሕክሙ ፡ እምኵሉ ፡ ኀጣይእክሙ ፡ ቅድመ ፡
                  እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወትነጽሑ ።
verses.translation: For in this day he shall make an atonement for you, to cleanse you from all your sins before the Lord, and ye shall be purged.

translations.lxx: For in this day he shall make an atonement for you, to cleanse you from all your sins before the Lord, and ye shall be purged.
translations.kjv: For on that day shall the priest make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, that ye may be clean from all your sins before the LORD.
translations.ron: Căci în ziua aceasta vi se face curăţire, ca să fiţi curaţi de toate păcatele voastre, înaintea Domnului, şi curaţi veţi fi.
translations.grk: Ἐν γὰρ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ ἐξιλάσεται περὶ ὑμῶν, καθαρίσαι ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ πασῶν τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ὑμῶν ἔναντι Κυρίου, καὶ καθαρισθήσεσθε.

verses.geez: እስመ ፡ ሰንበተ ፡ ሰናብት ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ለክሙ ፡ ወአሕምምዋ ፡ ለነፍስክሙ ፡ ወሕግ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ለክሙ ፡ ዘለዓለም ።
verses.translation: This shall be to you a most holy sabbath, a rest, and ye shall humble your souls; it is a perpetual ordinance.

translations.lxx: This shall be to you a most holy sabbath, a rest, and ye shall humble your souls; it is a perpetual ordinance.
translations.kjv: It shall be a sabbath of rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.
translations.ron: Aceasta e cea mai mare zi de odihnă pentru voi şi să smeriţi sufletele voastre prin post. Aceasta este lege veşnică.
translations.grk: Σάββατα σαββάτων ἀνάπαυσις αὕτη ἔσται ὑμῖν· καὶ ταπεινώσετε τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν, νόμιμον αἰώνιον.

verses.geez:
ወያስተሰሪ ፡ ካህን ፡ ዘቀብእዎ ፡ ወዘፈጸሙ ፡ እደዊሁ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይኩን ፡ ካህነ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ወይለብስ ፡
                  አልባሰ ፡ ዐጌ ፡ አልባሰ ፡ ቅድሳት ።
verses.translation: The priest whomsoever they shall anoint shall make atonement, and whomsoever they shall consecrate to exercise the priestly office after his father; and he shall put on the linen robe, the holy garment.

translations.lxx: The priest whomsoever they shall anoint shall make atonement, and whomsoever they shall consecrate to exercise the priestly office after his father; and he shall put on the linen robe, the holy garment.
translations.kjv: And the priest, whom he shall anoint, and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest’s office in his father’s stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen clothes, even the holy garments:
translations.ron: De curăţit însă să vă cureţe preotul care este uns ca să slujească în locul tatălui său.
translations.grk: Ἐξιλάσεται ὁ ἱερεὺς, ὃν ἂν χρίσωσιν αὐτὸν, καὶ ὃν ἂν τελειώσωσι τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ ἱερατεύειν μετὰ τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ· καὶ ἐνδύσεται τὴν στολὴν τὴν λινῆν, στολὴν ἁγίαν.

verses.geez:
ወያስተሰሪ ፡ በቅዱሰ ፡ ቅዱሳን ፡ ወበደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል ፡ ወበምሥዋዕ ፡ ያስተሰሪ ፡ ወበእንተ ፡ ካህናትኒ ፡ ወበእንተ
                  ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ተዓይን ፡ ያስተሰሪ ።
verses.translation: And he shall make atonement for the most holy place, and the tabernacle of witness; and he shall make atonement for the altar, and for the priests; and he shall make atonement for all the congregation.

translations.lxx: And he shall make atonement for the most holy place, and the tabernacle of witness; and he shall make atonement for the altar, and for the priests; and he shall make atonement for all the congregation.
translations.kjv: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar, and he shall make an atonement for the priests, and for all the people of the congregation.
translations.ron: Să se îmbrace el cu veşmintele cele de în şi cu veşmintele sfinte; şi va curăţi sfânta sfintelor, cortul adunării, va curăţi jertfelnicul şi pe preoţi şi va curăţi şi toată obştea poporului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξιλάσεται τὸ ἅγιον τοῦ ἁγίου, καὶ τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου, καὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον ἐξιλάσεται, καὶ περὶ τῶν ἱερέων, καὶ περὶ πάσης συναγωγῆς ἐξιλάσεται.

verses.geez:
ወዝንቱ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ይኩንክሙ ፡ ዘለዓለም ፡ ከመ ፡ ያስተስሪ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ኀጣይኢሆሙ
                  ፡ ወምዕረ ፡ ለዓመት ፡ ይገብሮ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ።
verses.translation: And this shall be to you a perpetual statute to make atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins: it shall be done once in the year, as the Lord commanded Moses.

translations.lxx: And this shall be to you a perpetual statute to make atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins: it shall be done once in the year, as the Lord commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year. And he did as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.ron: Aceasta să fie pentru voi lege veşnică: o dată în an să curăţiţi pe fiii lui Israel de păcatele lor". Şi Aaron a făcut aşa cum poruncise Domnul lui Moise.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται τοῦτο ὑμῖν νόμιμον αἰώνιον ἐξιλάσκεσθαι περὶ τῶν νἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ ἀπὸ πασῶν τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν· ἅπαξ τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ ποιηθήσεται, καθὰ συνέταξε Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ.
